main_text.l: Romanus] Romanicus, Cat. Romanensis, Salust. Romulea urbs. Sil. Romulus: Romula tellus, Virg. Romulidæ (Romana gens) Lucr.
Roralis] Rorulentus, Col. Roscidus, Var. Rorans capillus. Roratæ rosæ, Ovid. Rorifluus, Var. Rorifer, Lucr.
Rorat] Rorat imbrem, Plin. Irrorat. Stillat arbor rore Col. Stillare rorem, Hor.
Ros] Concretura vaporum. Pluvia insensilis. Pabulum herbarum. Aleman Lyricus, Rorem solis vel aëris & lunæ filiam dixit.
Rosaceus] Rhodinus: rhodinum unguentum, oleum, Pl. Roscidus, vid. Roralis.
Rosmarius] Ros marinus: marinus ros: Ros-marinum, Col. Ros maris, Ovid. Libanotis, idis. Plin. Libanotis coronaria, Iun.
Rostrare] Plin. Ferire rostrò, Liv. Rostro everberat os, vel oculos alicui corvus, Quint.
Rotundare] Globare. Circinare in orbem, Plin. Decircinare, Manil. Circulare, Amm. Gyrare, Plin. Corrotundari grando dicitur, apud Sen.
Rotunditas] Rotundatio turris, Vitr. Globositas, Macrob. Circumferentia, Apul. Circinatio, Vitr.
Rotundus] Rotundissima ova, Col. Globosus. Orbiculatus, Cic. Sphæralis forma, Macr. Gyratus orbis, Plin. In rotundum habitum figurata acies, Amm. Glomerosus, Col. Totus teres atque rotundus.

Ruber] Rubens, Rubeus, Virg. Rubicundus, Var. Rubicundulus, Iuv. Rubellus, Mart. Rubricosus, Plin. Rubidus, Fest. Sanguinolentus, Ovid. Phœniceus, Plaut. Rubellianæ vites, Col. Carbunculans. Carbunculosus, Plin.
Rubere] Rubescere, Plin. Subrubet cœlum. Ruborem trahere.

page.notes: Some words are uncertain in the scan: "Rorifer" and "Roseum" (the printed heading reads "Rosetum") are as printed; the running head and entries are otherwise as printed. The printed heading "Rosetum" was read as "Roseum" and "Roscidus" reads as printed.
